generatedFrom: the module registry, populated by importing every module subpath

modules.title: Asset catalogue
modules.summary: Named procedural props, built through one owner so teardown happens exactly once, and seeded from one fork-per-id stream so the same id yields the same geometry on every run. DOM-free and SSR-safe.

options.name: definitions
options.summary: extra prop definitions on top of the built-in presets

options.name: only
options.summary: expose only these preset names

options.name: defaults
options.summary: per-preset option defaults — where a scene house style lives

options.name: cache
options.summary: hand the same instance back for the same id; off because two props are usually two objects

modules.title: Camera rig
modules.summary: The camera as a module: aims, re-frustums on resize, and optionally chases an object with damping. Publishes the generic camera-rig capability, so anything that wants to point the view can do so without knowing which projection it got.

options.name: kind
options.summary: which projection the rig drives; iso requires an orthographic camera on createApp

options.name: target
options.summary: the point the rig looks at

options.name: iso
options.summary: view size, flavor, yaw for the iso kind

options.name: follow
options.summary: offset, look-ahead and damping half-lives for the follow kind

options.name: followTarget
options.summary: resolved every tick, so the target may spawn after the rig mounts

modules.title: Renderer diagnostics
modules.summary: Audits shader program linking at start (a program that will not link kills the context on the first draw, and looks thermal) and samples draw calls, memory and frame time while the app runs.

options.name: audit
options.summary: run the program link audit at start; skipped when there is no GL context

options.name: every
options.summary: ticks between renderer.info samples

options.name: onSample
options.summary: feed a HUD or a telemetry sink

modules.title: Pointer input
modules.summary: Accumulates pointer, wheel and pinch events and publishes them as state as of the current tick, with a camera-aware raycast helper. Read it in update; a handler that writes the scene from an event is the classic break in the unidirectional flow.

options.name: at
options.summary: mirror the pointer into app state under this key; omit to keep it out of state

options.name: gesture
options.summary: tap detection thresholds

modules.title: Standard lighting
modules.summary: IBL environment + warm shadow-casting sun + hemisphere fill. The default rig for anything lit with physical materials; mount it before the content that needs the environment map.

options.name: env
options.summary: PMREM room-environment IBL; false for a stylized flat look or a headless test

options.name: sun
options.summary: colour, intensity, position, and the shadow frustum/map size

options.name: hemi
options.summary: sky/ground fill colours and intensity

modules.title: Orbit controls
modules.summary: Drag to rotate, pinch or wheel to zoom, around a fixed target. View-only camera manipulation, deliberately outside app state — like scrolling a page.

options.name: rotateSpeed
options.summary: radians of rotation per dragged CSS pixel

options.name: zoomSpeed
options.summary: zoom factor per wheel deltaY unit

options.name: radius
options.summary: orbit radius clamp

options.name: maxPhi
options.summary: vertical angle clamp in radians, ± from horizontal

options.name: target
options.summary: the point the camera orbits and looks at

modules.title: Persisted state slice
modules.summary: Restores one state key from storage during build — as a queued commit, so no module sees a half-restored world — and writes it back on a timer when it changed. Storage is synchronous; touching it per tick is a stutter.

options.name: key
options.summary: storage key; give each independent slice its own

options.name: at
options.summary: the state key this module owns, restores and writes back

options.name: initial
options.summary: seeded into state[at] when there is nothing stored

options.name: fields
options.summary: which fields to persist; omit for the whole slice

options.name: interval
options.summary: seconds between writes

options.name: version
options.summary: a stored slice from another build is discarded, not merged

modules.title: Fixed-step rigid bodies
modules.summary: A cannon-es world stepped at a fixed rate with an accumulator, so the same tick sequence produces the same pile of barrels. Bind three objects to bodies with add(); the module syncs transforms after every step.

options.name: gravity
options.summary: acceleration in m/s²

options.name: step
options.summary: fixed simulation step in seconds; smaller is more stable and more expensive

options.name: maxSubSteps
options.summary: steps a single frame may run before time is dropped — the spiral-of-death guard

options.name: iterations
options.summary: constraint solver iterations; raise for stacks and cloth

options.name: allowSleep
options.summary: let resting bodies stop simulating

modules.title: Post-processing chain
modules.summary: An EffectComposer as a module: RenderPass -> optional UnrealBloom -> your passes -> OutputPass. Claims the frame draw, so mounting it is all the wiring there is. Ordered last on purpose.

options.name: bloom
options.summary: UnrealBloom in the base chain, or false to omit it

options.name: depth
options.summary: attach a shared depth texture — required by DOF, god rays, motion blur

options.name: effects
options.summary: build the custom passes to insert before tone-mapping

options.name: onFrame
options.summary: per-tick hook for time/camera-dependent pass uniforms

options.name: onResize
options.summary: per-resize hook for passes that track resolution in a plain uniform

modules.title: Quality governor
modules.summary: Picks a quality tier from device signals, measures frame time, steps down when the device cannot hold the budget, and remembers the verdict across loads. Publishes the tier so heavy modules size themselves to it instead of each guessing.

options.name: tiers
options.summary: the rungs, cheapest first

options.name: start
options.summary: starting rung by name; omit to pick from device signals

options.name: budgetMs
options.summary: frame-time ceiling; sustained frames slower than this drop a rung

options.name: patience
options.summary: consecutive over-budget ticks before dropping

options.name: memoryKey
options.summary: storage key so a tier that crashed once is not offered again

options.name: at
options.summary: mirror the tier and frame time into app state under this key
